preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N, K, S in parse_input(stdin))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of string S (N) is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for N, K, S in parse_input(stdin))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integer K is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.islower() and S.isalpha() for N, K, S in parse_input(stdin))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string S contains only lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K, S in parse_input(stdin)) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S_prime) == N for S_prime in parse_output(stdout))
postconditions.description: The length of the output string S' for each test case equals the length of the input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in S for c in S_prime) for S_prime in parse_output(stdout))
postconditions.description: Every character in the output string S' is present in the input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(all(S.count(c) == S_prime.count(c) for c in set(S)) for S_prime in parse_output(stdout))
postconditions.description: The output string S' contains each character from S with the same frequency as in S.

postconditions.expression: all(min_lex(S, K) == S_prime for S_prime in parse_output(stdout))
postconditions.description: The output string S' is the lexicographically smallest string that can be formed by partitioning S into exactly K non-empty subsequences and concatenating them.
